facts.fact: ZIMSTAT's report cites the Zimbabwe 2022 Population and Housing Census as counting 15,178,957 people, 61.4 percent of them in rural areas.
ZIMSTAT's report cites the Zimbabwe 2022 Population and Housing Census Report for the population by sex and rural or urban location.
